label: Land cover: Water share
source: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m Annual Land Use Land Cover (io-lulc-annual-v02, Sentinel-2) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
native_resolution: 10 m (sampled at 80 m via COG overview)
aggregation: class pixels / all classified pixels (excl. no-data, cloud) x 100; nearest-neighbour systematic 1-in-64 sample of the 10 m map
notes: Annual product dated YYYY-07-01, years 2017-2023 (2024+ not on Planetary Computer). Year-to-year changes partly reflect classifier differences; flooded vegetation and water shares react to the 2019-2022 floods.
